prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web app composition study, 16:9 landscape
Primary request: Design a complete desktop solving screen for the murder deduction puzzle ALIBI, within the fixed cinematic evidence-reconstruction world. Render a coherent application interface with semantic regions, not a poster, photograph, cinematic still, moodboard, cover, or decorative scene.
Structure: minimal top navigation with case title and timer; a tall contact-sheet suspect index on the left; a large illustrated square 4x4 house board offset slightly right of center; a compact evidence stack around the board that never obscures playable cells; a narrow state/tool strip at the bottom; an anchored Accuse action; visible progress.
Use real product content: MIDNIGHT DELIVERY; Tomas marked VICTIM; Alexander — On the lamp; Greta — The only person on the shower; Carol — The only person on the bathtub; labeled Study, Bathroom, Living Room; progress 0/4; Place, Mark, Undo, Redo, Clear, Hint x3, Accuse. Board furniture must be recognizable: shower, bathtub, bookshelf, lamp, sofa, desk, box.
Visual world: 1940s cinema evidence wall translated into a precise modern puzzle surface. Matte near-black magnetic steel; graphite and smoky olive; bone-white photo labels; projector amber for selection and active evidence line; oxblood only for accusation/conflict. Perforated film edges, contact-print crop marks, numbered magnets, grease-pencil connectors, shallow oblique projector glow. The illustrated board remains colorful, tactile, and very legible, the brightest object.
Typography: condensed industrial sans for names, narrow technical labels, monospaced clue text. Sharp corners, clipped tabs, disciplined density. No generic rounded cards, pills, glass, neon cyberpunk, cream parchment dashboard, skeuomorphic clutter, floating toolbar, or tiny illegible labels.
Composition option C — Connected Evidence Wall: selecting one suspect highlights their portrait, clue strip, and a single taut amber path to the relevant board feature; other evidence recedes. The board and dossier overlap spatially only through lines, never through panels. Mobile intent should be evident through stackable modules and one persistent bottom tool rail.
Show the full solving screen and complete action hierarchy. No invented claims, testimonials, pricing, logos, watermark, or fake commercial text.
